$summary: The spacing scale and the rolled-up roles that name a spacing situation.

space.summary: The spacing scale, plus rolled-up roles (gap/stack/padding/control/page/section) that name a specific spacing situation instead of a raw step.
use: Every margin, padding, and gap — prefer the matching role (space.gap.md, space.page.gutter, …) over a raw step when one names the situation.
dont: An arbitrary pixel value anywhere spacing is needed.

scale.gap.xs: Tightest inline gap, e.g. an icon and its label.
scale.gap.md: The default gap between related inline items.
scale.gap.lg: A looser gap between grouped inline items.
scale.stack.2xs: The tightest vertical step: a control and the label or helper text bound to it, where stack.xs still reads as separation. Note the line-height of the text either side adds leading on top of this, so the perceived gap is larger than the number.
scale.stack.xs: Tightest vertical rhythm, e.g. a label and its helper text.
scale.stack.sm: Compact vertical rhythm within a component.
scale.stack.md: The default vertical gap between stacked elements.
scale.stack.lg: A looser vertical gap between sections of one component.
scale.section: Vertical gap between major page sections.
scale.control.padding-inline.sm: Horizontal padding for a size.control.sm control.
scale.control.padding-inline.md: Horizontal padding for a size.control.md control.
scale.control.padding-inline.lg: Horizontal padding for a size.control.lg control.
scale.page.block-start: Vertical padding above a page's first section.
scale.page.block-end: Vertical padding below a page's last section.
scale.16: 64px. Extends the 4px scale by its own rule (step n = n × 4px) for the gap between page bands; not a component spacing step.
scale.24: 96px. The scale stops here — the widest gap a page needs, between bands on a wide screen.
scale.band.sm: Vertical gap between full-width page bands (hero → features → pricing) below breakpoint.wide.
scale.band.lg: The same gap at breakpoint.wide and above. Not space.section, which separates sections inside one region of a page.
scale.grid.gap: Gap between the columns and rows of a block's grid — a feature grid, pricing cards. Same value as space.page.gutter today, and a different job: the gutter is the page's edge, this is the space between items.

notes: space.16 and space.24 extend the 4px scale by its own naming rule for page-band rhythm only. The scale stops at 24 (96px); a gap larger than that is a layout decision, not a spacing step. space.band.* and space.grid.gap are the roles that use them — reach for those, not the raw steps.
